messages:
Maya S.: Heads up — customers hitting 401s and doubled billing after we upgraded to python-sdk 1.36. Reports started ~yesterday after pip upgrade.

Devon P.: Ugh. Any repro steps? sample code or auth changes?

Maya S.: Repro is pretty small. If I init client with default signer it seems to emit a different `Authorization` header shape and server rejects, then client retries and we end up with duplicate charge events. Snippet: 
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])
resp = client.chat.create(model='rwd-1', messages=[{'role':'user','content':'hi'}])
```
Works on 1.35.2, fails on 1.36.0 with 401 then retry 200 -> duplicate billing.

Ana R.: Can you paste raw request headers from a failing run? Also which retry policy used (default/backoff)?

Maya S.: Logs: 
```
-> POST /v1/chat  Authorization: Bearer <token_v1>  content-type: application/json
<- 401 Unauthorized  {"error":"invalid_auth","hint":"signer_signature_mismatch"}
(retry) -> POST /v1/chat  Authorization: RedwoodAuth sig=v2...  content-type: application/json
<- 200 OK  {"id":"chat_abc123"}
```
Seems like v1 bearer vs new `RedwoodAuth` token format when signer present. Not consistent across processes.

Devon P.: Hmm. We changed Signer interface in 1.36 to support streaming pre-signed headers. Looks like a migration bug where old env-var flow still produces Bearer but retry uses new signer flow. That would explain 401 then success on retry.

Riley (SRE): Escalating to eng-runtime. For now recommend pinning.

Devon P.: Agreed. Workaround: pin to 1.35.2 or explicitly pass auth header to bypass signer change. Example: 
```python
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=None, headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {os.environ["REDWOOD_KEY"]}'})
```
This prevents new signer from being applied.

Ana R.: Also add a quick check in integration tests: assert no 401 followed by 200 for same request id within a short window.

support-bot: Ticket created: SUP-2026 — "py-sdk 1.36 signer migration causing auth mismatch + duplicate billing" :white_check_mark:

Maya S.: Pin+workaround validated with our QA fleet. Rolling customers back to 1.35.2 for now. Thanks. :thumbsup:

Riley (SRE): Eng-runtime triage scheduled 09:00PT. We'll patch asap and push a micro-release with a rollback flag.

Devon P.: Follow-up: I'll prepare a short advisory for customers: pin to 1.35.2 and apply header workaround if they must use 1.36.0. Add example for pip: `pip install redwood==1.35.2`

Maya S.: Adding which repos were affected: webchat, support-billing-proxy, mobile-bff.

Ana R.: Noted. I'll update the incident doc with mitigation and link to SUP-2026.

Maya S.: Thanks all — will monitor for eng fix.
